'''Chapter 379''' is titled "Doriki".

==Cover Page==
[[Cover Page#Color Spread|Color Spread]]: "Summer Time."

The Straw Hats relax on a tropical isle, the men (apart from a napping [[Tony Tony Chopper|Chopper]]) baiting their fishing poles with [[Nami]]'s swimsuit pictures. Already, they've made two catches: [[Sanji]] and a lion in an inner-tube.

==Short Summary==
The [[CP9]] reunion appears more of a comedy show as [[Monkey D. Luffy]] continues on his way towards the courthouse.

==Long Summary==
The [[CP9]] are all reunited as [[Rob Lucci]] confirms that both [[Franky|Cutty Flam]] and [[Nico Robin|Robin]] are in custody. Despite this, both Lucci and [[Jabra]] appear to show rivalry between one and other while both [[Kaku]] and [[Kumadori]] tell them to calm down and show affection towards their long seen friends. All of a sudden, the four returning CP9 attack [[Fukurou]] and it is revealed that he can count their strength in [[Doriki]] and he orders all the members in strength. Despite the reunion turning more into a comedy show, [[Spandam]] interrupts them and shows them a chest with two [[Devil Fruit]]s. Nico Robin and Franky are then brought into the room and as Spandam insults [[Tom]], Franky bites his head and Robin watches as he is then taken down by [[Kumadori]].

While this is happening, it is seen that Spandam's [[Den Den Mushi]] has been left off the hook preventing him from finding out the trouble being caused on the island. [[Monkey D. Luffy|Luffy]] continues towards the courthouse where the three headed judge, [[Baskerville]], waits.

==Quick Reference==
===Chapter Notes===
*The [[CP9]]'s [[Doriki]] (power levels) are revealed. To compare, a typical Navy guardsman has a Doriki of 10.
**[[Rob Lucci]] has a Doriki of 4000. According to Jabra, such a high number has never been reached.
**[[Kaku]] has a Doriki of 2200.
**[[Jabra]] has a Doriki of 2180.
**[[Blueno]] has a Doriki of 820.
**[[Kumadori]] has a Doriki of 810. 
**[[Fukurou]] has a Doriki of 800.
**[[Kalifa]] has a Doriki of 630.
**[[Spandam]] has a Doriki of 9.
**Spandam also mentions that a person is considered superhuman if their Doriki is at least 500.
*Jabra is also a [[Devil Fruit]] user and appears to be a [[Zoan]] type.
*Spandam is in possession of two Devil Fruits.
*The [[Enies Lobby]] judge, [[Baskerville]] is summoned.
